scripts.build: node scripts/local-guard.mjs --class standard --machine 3090 -- npm run build:direct --
scripts.build:direct: node scripts/local-guard.mjs --require npm run build && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.headless.json && node scripts/bake-terrain.mjs && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/local-guard.mjs --class quick --machine any -- npm run typecheck:direct --
scripts.typecheck:direct: node scripts/local-guard.mjs --require npm run typecheck && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.headless.json
scripts.test:fast: node scripts/local-guard.mjs --class standard --machine any -- npm run test:fast:direct --
scripts.test:fast:direct: node scripts/local-guard.mjs --require npm run test:fast && node scripts/guard-architecture.mjs --quiet && node scripts/test-build.mjs --typecheck && node scripts/test-tier.mjs fast
scripts.test:heavy: scripts/heavy-check.sh --class heavy-suite -- sh -c 'node scripts/test-build.mjs && node scripts/test-tier.mjs heavy'
scripts.check: npm run test:fast && npm run test:heavy && npm run build
scripts.playthrough: node scripts/local-guard.mjs --class playthrough --machine any -- npm run playthrough:direct --
scripts.playthrough:direct: node scripts/local-guard.mjs --require npm run playthrough && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p scripts/playthrough/tsconfig.json && node .test-build/scripts/playthrough/run.js
